text: Looking at housing today, the math makes no sense at all.
A lavish penthouse in Mumbai and a condo in Manhattan can easily cost 15 million bucks,
giant piles of cash.
Yet in the old Europe lands, using the exact same money, you can buy a stone castle built
in the Middle Ages, with morts, tall stone walls, and noble dynastic past.
In Delhi, you inhale toxic smoke in Manhattan, you face endless, stalled lanes, all supply
and demand has completely vanished.
Now think about this, if you and I walk into a bank in Miami, Boston, Mumbai, Dallas,
and ask to take a loan, double what we make, they laugh at us, and shut the gate.
And if someone cannot pay, then finish.
The bank takes the home, the bank impounds the auto, and that human loses all financial
peace.
What happens when a whole nation does it, when Washington owes past tens of thousands
of billions and global politicians take loans endlessly, they do not go into default, no one
evokes the White House, instead politicians want to lift that debt cap.
Tonight we examine the ultimate illusion, the deep money corn, and who pays the tab, the lazy,
the wicked?
No.
It punishes the honest, disciplined human who saves cash.
The system is not failing, it functions exactly as designed, you and I play a face game.
Look at the official data, digits do not lie, total debt on the globe, exploded past all
sane limits, tens of thousands of billions, Japan owes 2.6 times its total economic output.
Washington passes massive new debt peaks, and now the nation spends a full thousand billion
bucket each 12 months, just to pay the holding face on its debt, that exceeds its whole defense
budget.
India and developing giants must fight the same incoming tide.
By all textbooks, this should have collapsed, so why hasn't it?
Because the villain is not the debt itself, the villain is delusion.
When a system sings in unpayable debt, politicians do not pay, the titans holding solid assets
do not pay, you do.
Think of a simple spot in town, imagine two apples and two men, each man holds 10 bucks,
the apple cost 10 bucks.
Now imagine the state means new cash slips, and hands each human 20 bucks instead.
The count of apples did not expand, so each apple instantly jumps to 20 bucks, that is inflation.
Now behold the quiet corn, new money does not fall on all man at once.
The human who touches that new money at the fountain had wins the whole pot.
This is not an accident of today, this is an ancient looping cycle, and it follows an unmistakable
line of logic.
Go back to ancient Italy, and it speaks that letting state held vast dominions, dozens
of legions defending distant outposts, each fighting man expected payment again, each fighting
man expected payment daily.
The official letting coin was solid white bullion, I hope I am pronouncing it right.
At the peak it was almost untainted, shining metal, you could step into any town, and that coin
bought you meat, wine and a better title, man put complete faith in it.
Then came endless battle zone distant plains, the public world was empty, and no chief of state
wanted to face fighting legions to announce that money had vanished.
So politicians made a fateful move, instead of paying legions in solid white bullion,
they melted the coins and injected cheap tin and zinc, just a tiny bit at dawn, nobody
noticed.
Then additional cheap metal, then double that.
In 50 seasons the white metal in that coin collapsed, falling off 910s of clean bullion, down
to less than 120th.
Think of what that did to a fighting man, he took home the exact same count of coins each
moon.
The coins looked authentic on the face, yet when he walked into the shop to buy a meal,
the shop doubled the tab, then pushed it up 10 fold.
Because the man at the stall also found out, the coin was hollow.
Same count of coins less than half the meal, that man was not in pain because he told less.
He was in pain because the state diluted the value way ahead of him.
This is coin dilution, and it dismantled that Latin state with lethal speed.
Now jump ahead to 1720.
The old kingdom of Louis was deep in debt.
Cosly clashes had emptied the public vaults, the nation was insolvent, few jobs, no loans,
then stabbed in a shady math mind named John Law.
He told the politicians what they longed to accept, abandoned gold coins, issue fear bank
notes instead.
Set up a massive estate monopoly, give it exclusive shipping lanes, use newly minted bank
notes to fund public tasks and employment.
The economy will bounce back.
The state said yes, they had no options.
Initially, it succeeded, men had cash in pockets, they spent it, shops opened, people found jobs.
The stock of that monopoly exploded thousands of times above base value.
The capital felt like a boom down.
Now look at what common folks did not see, Cantillon, an astute banking mind allied with
John Law, quietly bought solid physical assets, using unspent cash at all tags, land, gold,
tangible goods, all ahead of the moment when the public saw bank notes flooding town.
By the time that newly stamped cash laid down to common folks, cost had multiplied, doubled,
saved tenfold.
Common men held heaps of fear notes yet could buy less food.
The few men closed us to the issuing desk bought solid assets at low tags, wealth accumulated
in few hands.
When the bubble popped in 1720, John Law fled in disguise.
Cantillon was wealthy and common folk holding piles of dead fear slips, unable to buy a
simple meal.
In coins diluted with tin, new bank notes stamped on pulp, distinct tools, identical outcome,
elite minds at the top scoop up solid assets ahead of inflation.
The humble base accepts diluted tokens when all goods become costly.
Now you see the ancient logic behold the exact same play unfolding at this moment, using
silicon chips instead of cheap tin.
In 2020, when the pandemic hit, the Fed held a sudden weekend session.
They made a move, imagined all of human history.
Thousands of billions of new digital bucks, minted in months, not stamped on cotton slips,
typed onto glowing displays, that is the new coin, that is the new mint.
At the exact same moment, India pushed giant sums of cash.
All top state banks on the globe did the same thing.
Japan, China, the EU, all of them typed new money into existence.
Now the essential question, into what pocket did that cash flow?
The Fed pushes new money into big lending houses, those lending houses got told, push it out
fast, get it moving.
Lending houses do not hand that cash to a humble technician in Mumbai who might lose his
job.
They do not give it to a small shop in Texas, that might fold next week, that looks unsafe
to them.
They lent to established mega funds and monopolies, at almost nil cost in holding fees.
In the US massive buyout funds, tapped that cheap liquidity to buy out thousands of family
homes.
In 2021 alone, common families seeking a modest house stood no chance against institutional
buying machines.
Not bid, beaten, time and time again.
In India, elite business giants moved fast.
One dominant business tightened, bought up multiple falling companies, medical apps, daily
milk supply lines, wholesale chain, bought up discounted tags with small shop bosses closed
up shop.
Then came the next stage, speculative tech teams.
Big banks had to place capital into shiny new concept, so plug in autos, sun and wind
tech and dispatch apps, found bottomless funding.
See how this plays out, a tech team takes loans of immense scale at nil holding fees that
cash flows into a massive assembly plant as a huge bulk buy.
The assembly plant logs in incoming cash and uses it to expand its massive facilities.
The tech team blows its loan, then shuts down.
The assembly plant keeps the physical machines and the tech team bosses, they set up an LLC.
They pay themselves consulting fees legally.
They buy solid asset ahead of the incoming inflation wave, penthouses in Mumbai, high end condos
in Manhattan.
You see it now?
This is not a flop.
This is the machine functioning as plant.
Ancient Italy, melted coins, the old kingdoms, stamped notes, today we type digits onto glowing
displays.
The pipeline is identical.
So what does this mean to you and me?
Look back at dads and moms decades ago.
In the 1970s in the US, a single middle class income, easily bought a family home on a quiet
lane in India, decades back, a dad with a modest desk job, bought a quiet plot of soil and
paid local machines to build a home.
Can today's top coding talent in Austin and Ali tech mines in Delhi buy that same physical
soil on a base wage, almost impossible.
You hold diplomas, you spend long days and nights, yet you slide behind.
We get told that the whole globe is booming, yet one solid unit of human sweat, by as less
physical stuff than decades ago.
That is why a lavish penthouse in Mumbai and a tall glass building in Manhattan cost 15
million bucks, that is the basin into which all diluted cash pools.
If you leave saved funds in a checking account, the system quietly melts it down.
Officials use those melting savings to pay off unpayable public debt.
The only solid move is owning tangible assets, equity in cash, positive companies that lift
tags with inflation, housing and land, whose debt melts as time flows by.
Stop fighting a massive ocean tide, the tide wins each single time.
Stop swimming, build a boat.
See you next time.
